package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

// scenario for fmt_fprintf_single_string_to_strings_builder: `fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "%s", s)` instead of `WriteString(s)`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario487Positive(values []string) string {
	var builder strings.Builder
	for _, s := range values {
		fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "%s", s)
	}
	return builder.String()
}
